name: Circulation
overview: Rigid blood vessels attached to the heart are called arteries. The cardiac cycle includes blood flows into arteries. As though the blood was trying to flow toward the heart.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Rigid blood vessels attached to the _____ are called arteries.
vsaq.answer: Rigid blood vessels attached to the heart are called arteries.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: The cardiac cycle includes _____ flows into arteries.
vsaq.answer: The cardiac cycle includes blood flows into arteries.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Relaxation of atria called one cardiac cycle. and _____.
vsaq.answer: Relaxation of atria called one cardiac cycle. and ventricles.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: _____ closed (Lub) repeated are called cardiac cycle.
vsaq.answer: Valves closed (Lub) repeated are called cardiac cycle.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: _____ is absorbed by osmosis from the soil by the root hairs.
vsaq.answer: Water is absorbed by osmosis from the soil by the root hairs.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: This fluid flows through a _____ called as lymphatic system.
vsaq.answer: This fluid flows through a system called as lymphatic system.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: These are root _____ through which water enters the plant.
vsaq.answer: These are root hairs through which water enters the plant.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: Any structure that divides two _____ is known as septum.
vsaq.answer: Any structure that divides two chambers is known as septum.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: So, water passes into the neighbouring cell which in turn becomes diluted, finally water enters the xylem _____.
vsaq.answer: So, water passes into the neighbouring cell which in turn becomes diluted, finally water enters the xylem vessels.

vsaq.question: Complete the key idea: The valve present on the _____ Auriculo-ventricular septum between Right atrium and Right Ventricle is referred to as “Tricuspid Valve”.
vsaq.answer: The valve present on the Right Auriculo-ventricular septum between Right atrium and Right Ventricle is referred to as “Tricuspid Valve”.
